full_details: At the morning rehearsal you ran the join in the book as it is played, and you put nothing back. In the afternoon you were Gaunt, done in the second act, to a full house on a raw day. Margery counted gowns, citizens, and two bishops' men, and at the back of the twopenny room an old gentleman in a frieze cloak who paid for three. He struck the rail. She took it for clapping. Heminges guessed a country justice up for the term. You did not know him for anyone else. At home you sat, and you struck a false start before her face. The line is not on the sheet. The Rose bill was Barnardo, and you did not cross.
one_sentence: You played Gaunt for the sixth time, with the jaw whole, and heard of a man in a frieze cloak.
title: A fist, taken for clapping
